hints.title: Frequency Counting
hints.text: Count the total occurrences of each distinct integer in the array using element counters.

hints.title: Divisibility Filter
hints.text: Check each unique element to see if its occurrence count modulo k equals zero.

hints.title: Accumulation
hints.text: For qualifying elements, add the product of value and count to the running total.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Hash map frequency tally with single pass summation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-counting occurrences per element results in O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) hash map storage for unique values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use hash map for linear frequency counting and selective summation.
